        name = oe_col.1.a

    }
    option = {
        name = oe_col.1.b
        trigger = { has_variable = oe_col_group gold >= oe_col_cost_out }

        hidden_effect = {
            add_gold = { value = oe_col_cost_out multiply = -1 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_job value = 12 }
            trigger_event_silently = oe_col.99
        }
        ai_chance = {
            base = 25
            modifier = { add = 20 OR = { at_war = yes scope:oe_col_theme ?= { var:oe_theme_status ?= 2 } } }
            modifier = { factor = 0 gold < oe_col_m4 }
        }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_col.1.c
        custom_tooltip = oe_col.1.c.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
                change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = 1 }

oe_col.22 = { # 商站失陷
    type = country_event
    outcome = negative
    image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/government/geopolitics_illustration.dds"
    title = oe_col.22.t
    desc = {
        first_valid = {
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { var:oe_col_lost_why ?= 1 } desc = oe_col.22.d1 }
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { var:oe_col_lost_why ?= 2 } desc = oe_col.22.d2 }
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { var:oe_col_lost_why ?= 4 } desc = oe_col.22.d3 }
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { var:oe_col_lost_why ?= 5 } desc = oe_col.22.d4 }
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { always = yes } desc = oe_col.22.d5 }
        }
    }
    trigger = { is_rebel_country = no tag = BYZ oe_col_ev_ok_22 = yes }
    immediate = {
        oe_ml_take_as = { line = 16 }
        var:oe_col_lost_loc ?= { save_scope_as = oe_col_site owner ?= { save_scope_as = oe_col_host } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_col_lost_why ?= 1 } add_gold = { value = oe_col_m1 multiply = -1 } }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_col.22.a
        trigger = {
            exists = scope:oe_col_host
            OR = { var:oe_col_lost_why ?= 1 var:oe_col_lost_why ?= 3 var:oe_col_lost_why ?= 5 }
        }
        custom_tooltip = oe_col.22.a.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            scope:oe_col_host ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_col_op_claim target = c:BYZ } }
            random = {
                chance = 40
                set_variable = { name = oe_col_claim_due value = { value = oe_ml_month_now add = 3 } }
            }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_lost_loc } remove_variable = oe_col_lost_loc }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_lost_why } remove_variable = oe_col_lost_why }
        }
        ai_chance = { base = 30 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_col.22.b
        custom_tooltip = oe_col.22.b.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_lost_loc } remove_variable = oe_col_lost_loc }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_lost_why } remove_variable = oe_col_lost_why }
        }
        ai_chance = { base = 50 }
    }
    option = {

oe_col.24 = { # 罗马人请求设馆
    type = country_event
    outcome = neutral
    image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/government/geopolitics_illustration.dds"
    title = oe_col.24.t
    desc = oe_col.24.desc
    trigger = {
        country_exists = c:BYZ
        c:BYZ = {
            has_variable = oe_col_req_loc
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_ans }
            var:oe_col_req_loc ?= { owner ?= root }
        }
    }
    immediate = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_host_yes } remove_variable = oe_col_host_yes }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_host_price } remove_variable = oe_col_host_price }
        c:BYZ = {
            var:oe_col_req_loc ?= {
                save_scope_as = oe_col_site
                save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_col_ch value = oe_col_host_ch }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { is_ai = yes exists = scope:oe_col_ch }
            random = { chance = scope:oe_col_ch set_variable = { name = oe_col_host_yes days = 30 } }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_host_yes } c:BYZ = { oe_col_price_ok = yes } }
                random = { chance = 50 set_variable = { name = oe_col_host_price days = 30 } }
            }
        }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_col.24.a
        custom_tooltip = oe_col.24.a.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            c:BYZ = {
                if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = oe_col_req_loc NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_ans } }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_ans value = 1 }
                    oe_col_fire_21 = yes
                }
            }
        }
        ai_chance = { base = 0 modifier = { add = 100 has_variable = oe_col_host_yes } }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_col.24.b
        trigger = { c:BYZ = { oe_col_price_ok = yes } }
        custom_tooltip = oe_col.24.b.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            c:BYZ = {
                if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = oe_col_req_loc NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_ans } }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_ans value = 2 }
                    oe_col_fire_21 = yes
                }
            }
        }
        ai_chance = {
            base = 0
            modifier = { add = 100 has_variable = oe_col_host_price NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_host_yes } }
        }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_col.24.c
        custom_tooltip = oe_col.24.c.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            c:BYZ = {
                if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = oe_col_req_loc NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_ans } }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_ans value = 3 }
                    oe_col_fire_21 = yes
                }
            }
        }
        ai_chance = {
            base = 0
            modifier = {
                add = 100
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_host_yes }
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_host_price }
            }
        }
    }
}

oe_col.30 = { # 新殖民城
    type = country_event
    outcome = neutral
    image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/government/geopolitics_expansion_illustration.dds"
    title = oe_col.30.t
    desc = {
        first_valid = {
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { var:oe_col_c30_new ?= 1 } desc = oe_col.30.d1 }
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { always = yes } desc = oe_col.30.d2 }
        }
    }
    trigger = { is_rebel_country = no tag = BYZ oe_col_ev_ok_30 = yes }
    immediate = {
        oe_ml_take_as = { line = 16 }
        var:oe_col_c30_seat ?= { save_scope_as = oe_col_seat save_scope_as = oe_col_loc }
        var:oe_col_c30_theme ?= { save_scope_as = oe_col_theme }
        oe_col_find_source = yes
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_col.30.a
        trigger = { gold >= oe_col_m1 }
        custom_tooltip = oe_col.30.a.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            add_gold = { value = oe_col_m1 multiply = -1 }
            var:oe_col_c30_theme ?= { oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 5 } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_job value = 81 }
            trigger_event_silently = oe_col.99
        }
        ai_chance = { base = 45 modifier = { factor = 0 gold < oe_col_m2 } }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_col.30.b
        trigger = {
            var:oe_col_c30_new ?= 1
            gold >= oe_col_m1
            var:oe_col_c30_seat ?= { is_coastal = yes }
            var:oe_col_c30_theme ?= { oe_ta_can_change_course = yes oe_ta_course_ok_navy = yes }
        }
        custom_tooltip = oe_col.30.b.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            add_gold = { value = oe_col_m1 multiply = -1 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_job value = 82 }
            trigger_event_silently = oe_col.99
        }
        ai_chance = { base = 30 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_col.30.c
        trigger = { gold >= oe_col_m2 oe_col_slot_free = yes exists = scope:oe_col_src }
        custom_tooltip = oe_col.30.c.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            add_gold = { value = oe_col_m2 multiply = -1 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_job value = 83 }
            trigger_event_silently = oe_col.99
        }
        ai_chance = { base = 25 modifier = { factor = 0 gold < oe_col_m4 } }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_col.30.d
        custom_tooltip = oe_col.30.d.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_seat } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_seat }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_theme } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_theme }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_new } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_new }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_cmp } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_cmp }
        }
        ai_chance = { base = 5 }
    }
}

# (hidden) Colonia (founding): the work of oe_col_found_colonia, in scopes of its own. Failure codes (BYZ var oe_col_fc_fail, readout only):
#   1 the seat is no longer fit (not Byzantium's own, occupied, besieged, or already in a theme)
#   2 refused: another founding was still waiting (one at a time)
#   3 the new theme was not made (oe_tm_found_1 left no country)
#   4 joined a theme, but no theme building stands at the seat yet (post queued?)
#   5 a founding waited more than a month (its event never ran) and was dropped
#   6 oe_col.30 b: the theme could no longer change its course (the gold came back)
oe_col.31 = {
    type = country_event
    title = empty_text
    hidden = yes
    trigger = { is_rebel_country = no tag = BYZ has_variable = oe_col_fc_seat }
    immediate = {
        var:oe_col_fc_seat ?= { save_scope_as = oe_col_seat }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_seat scope:oe_col_seat = { oe_col_fc_ok = yes } }
            scope:oe_col_seat = { set_variable = oe_col_fc_land }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable_list = oe_col_fc_more }
                every_in_list = {
                    variable = oe_col_fc_more
                    limit = { oe_col_fc_ok = yes }
                    set_variable = oe_col_fc_land
                }
            }
            oe_col_fc_find_theme = yes
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_theme }
                every_owned_location = {
                    limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_land }
                    oe_theme_construct_post = { owner = scope:oe_col_theme }
                }
                scope:oe_col_theme = { save_scope_as = oe_col_new_th }
                set_variable = { name = oe_col_c30_new value = 0 }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:oe_col_seat = { NOT = { oe_theme_location_occupied_trigger = yes } } }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_fc_fail value = 4 }
                }
            }
            else = {
                scope:oe_col_seat = { save_scope_as = oe_tm_seat1 }
                oe_tm_found_1 = yes
                if = {
                    limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_th1 }
                    every_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_land } oe_tm_post = { n = 1 } }
                    oe_tm_set_new_status = { n = 1 }
                    scope:oe_tm_th1 = { save_scope_as = oe_col_new_th }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_c30_new value = 1 }
                }
                else = { set_variable = { name = oe_col_fc_fail value = 3 } }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_new_th }
                scope:oe_col_new_th = { set_variable = { name = oe_col_colonia value = 1 } }
                scope:oe_col_seat = {
                    add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_col_colonia_seat years = -1 mode = replace }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_colonia_at value = 1 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_colonia_n } }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_colonia_n value = 0 }
                }
                change_variable = { name = oe_col_colonia_n add = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_col_c30_seat value = scope:oe_col_seat }
                set_variable = { name = oe_col_c30_theme value = scope:oe_col_new_th }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_col_from_company ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_col_c30_cmp value = 1 } }
                else = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_cmp } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_cmp } }
                oe_col_fc_clean = yes
                oe_col_fire_30 = yes
            }
            else = { scope:oe_col_seat = { set_variable = { name = oe_col_fc_cd months = 12 } } }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_fc_fail value = 1 }
            scope:oe_col_seat ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_col_fc_cd months = 12 } }
        }
        oe_col_fc_clean = yes
    }
}

# (hidden) Resettlement (worker). The jobs (BYZ var oe_col_job):
#   11 oe_col.1 a: the internal move (add_migration from the most populous other province).
#   12 oe_col.1 b: foreign soldier families (add_pop, new people).
#   21 oe_col.2 a: the newcomers' deeds stand (their unrest lasts longer).
#   22 oe_col.2 b: the old settlers' custom wins (the newcomers' modifier becomes 'kept down').
#   23 oe_col.2 c: a judge surveys the bounds.
#   31 oe_col.10 a: the Nicomedian refugees move to empty land (Thrace first).
#   42 oe_col.3 b: the soldiers' sons become Romans.
#   46 oe_col.14 a: the steppe riders settle (oe_col_settle_p2, group 2 or 4).
#   51 oe_col.11 a: Albanians settle at 2 places of Thessaly (oe_col_settle_p2, group 1).
#   53 oe_col.11 c: the herdsmen are kept in the hills and raid the plain.
#   61 oe_col.12 a: Albanians settle at up to 3 places of Arcadia (oe_col_settle_p2, group 1).
#   62 oe_col.12 b: only some are let in (one place).
#   71 oe_col.21 a: the post opens (oe_col_post_open; the host's opinion; Genoa's, at Caffa or Tana under another master).
#   72 oe_col.21 b: the same, and the host is paid its price (the option took the gold).
#   73 oe_col.21 c: the same, for one tier of Genoa's privileges (D1's interface oe_itp_shift).
#   74 oe_col.21 d, e: no post; half the gold comes back, the site cools down 60 months.
#   76 the action oe_col_close_post: the post at BYZ var oe_col_close_loc closes (the site cools down 60 months).
#   77 oe_col.23 a: walls and a judge (level 2); a host on Genoa's or Venice's side takes it ill.
#   78 oe_col.23 b: things stay as they are; the host is pleased; not asked again for 10 years.
#   79 oe_col.23 c: a parish of the Patriarchate (D2's interface oe_ecc_pres_add); not asked again for 10 years.
#   81 oe_col.30 a: veterans' allotments at the seat (20 years).
#   82 oe_col.30 b: the new theme turns to the sea (the theme panel's own oe_ta_set_course); if it no longer can, the gold comes back (failure code 6).
#   83 oe_col.30 c: an internal move to the seat, exactly as job 11 (oe_col.1 a) but for the seat; takes a slot, not the action's cooldown.
oe_col.99 = {
    type = country_event
    title = empty_text
    hidden = yes
    trigger = { is_rebel_country = no tag = BYZ has_variable = oe_col_job }
    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 11 }
            var:oe_col_target ?= { save_scope_as = oe_col_loc }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_loc }
                oe_col_find_source = yes
                if = {
                    limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_src exists = scope:oe_col_amt }
                    add_migration = {
                        owner = root
                        from = scope:oe_col_src.province_definition
                        to_location = scope:oe_col_loc
                        amount = scope:oe_col_amt
                        months = 24
                        only_from_owned_locations = yes
                        keep_nationality = yes
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_pop_added } }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_pop_added value = 0 }
                    }
                    change_variable = { name = oe_col_pop_added add = { value = scope:oe_col_amt multiply = 24 } }
                    scope:oe_col_loc = {
                        add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_col_homesteads years = 10 mode = replace }
                    }
                    scope:oe_col_loc = {
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_cd years = 20 }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_kind value = 1 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_s1_loc } }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_s1_loc value = scope:oe_col_loc }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_s1_m value = 24 }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_s1_kind value = 1 }
                    }
                    else_if = {
                        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_s2_loc } }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_s2_loc value = scope:oe_col_loc }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_s2_m value = 24 }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_s2_kind value = 1 }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 12 }
            var:oe_col_target ?= { save_scope_as = oe_col_loc }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_loc has_variable = oe_col_group }
                oe_col_add_settlers = yes
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_pop_added } }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_pop_added value = 0 }
                }
                change_variable = { name = oe_col_pop_added add = 1.3 }
                scope:oe_col_loc = {
                    add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_col_foreign_settlers years = 20 mode = replace }
                    add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_col_newcomers years = 5 mode = replace }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_young years = 10 }
                }
                scope:oe_col_loc = {
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_cd years = 20 }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_kind value = 2 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_s1_loc } }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_s1_loc value = scope:oe_col_loc }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_s1_m value = 12 }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_s1_kind value = 2 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_s2_loc } }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_s2_loc value = scope:oe_col_loc }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_s2_m value = 12 }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_s2_kind value = 2 }
                }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 21 }
            var:oe_col_dsp_loc ?= { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_col_newcomers years = 3 mode = extend } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 22 }
            var:oe_col_dsp_loc ?= {
                if = {
                    limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_col_homesteads }
                    remove_location_modifier = oe_col_homesteads
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_col_foreign_settlers }
                    remove_location_modifier = oe_col_foreign_settlers
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_col_newcomers }
                    remove_location_modifier = oe_col_newcomers
                }
                add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_col_settlers_curbed years = 10 mode = replace }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 23 }
            var:oe_col_dsp_loc ?= {
                if = {
                    limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_col_newcomers }
                    remove_location_modifier = oe_col_newcomers
                }
                add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_col_surveyed years = 10 mode = replace }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 31 }
            var:oe_col_nic_city ?= { save_scope_as = oe_col_city }
            var:oe_col_nic_to ?= { save_scope_as = oe_col_loc }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_city exists = scope:oe_col_loc scope:oe_col_loc = { owner ?= c:BYZ } }
                add_migration = {
                    owner = root
                    from = scope:oe_col_city.province_definition
                    to_location = scope:oe_col_loc
                    amount = 0.15
                    months = 12
                    only_from_owned_locations = yes
                    keep_nationality = yes
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_pop_added } }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_pop_added value = 0 }
                }
                change_variable = { name = oe_col_pop_added add = 1.8 }
                scope:oe_col_loc = {
                    add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_col_homesteads years = 10 mode = replace }
                }
                scope:oe_col_city = {
                    add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_col_refugees_moved years = 1 mode = replace }
                }
                scope:oe_col_loc = {
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_cd years = 20 }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_kind value = 1 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { oe_col_slot_free = yes }
                    if = {
                        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_s1_loc } }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_s1_loc value = scope:oe_col_loc }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_s1_m value = 12 }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_s1_kind value = 1 }
                    }
                    else_if = {
                        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_s2_loc } }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_s2_loc value = scope:oe_col_loc }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_s2_m value = 12 }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_s2_kind value = 1 }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 42 }
            var:oe_col_sons_at ?= {
                add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_col_assimilating years = 20 mode = replace }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 46 }
            var:oe_col_stp_to ?= { save_scope_as = oe_col_loc }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_col_stp_g exists = scope:oe_col_loc }
                set_variable = { name = oe_col_p2_group value = var:oe_col_stp_g }
                oe_col_settle_p2 = yes
                remove_variable = oe_col_p2_group
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 51 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_p2_group value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_col_ths_1 }
                var:oe_col_ths_1 = { save_scope_as = oe_col_loc }
                oe_col_settle_p2 = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_col_ths_2 }
                var:oe_col_ths_2 = { save_scope_as = oe_col_loc }
                oe_col_settle_p2 = yes
            }
            remove_variable = oe_col_p2_group
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 53 }
            province_definition:thessaly_province = {
                every_location_in_province_definition = {
                    limit = { oe_col_site = yes }
                    add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_col_hill_raids years = 5 mode = replace }
                }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 61 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_p2_group value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_col_mor_1 }
                var:oe_col_mor_1 = { save_scope_as = oe_col_loc }
                oe_col_settle_p2 = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_col_mor_2 }
                var:oe_col_mor_2 = { save_scope_as = oe_col_loc }
                oe_col_settle_p2 = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_col_mor_3 }
                var:oe_col_mor_3 = { save_scope_as = oe_col_loc }
                oe_col_settle_p2 = yes
            }
            remove_variable = oe_col_p2_group
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 62 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_p2_group value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_col_mor_1 }
                var:oe_col_mor_1 = { save_scope_as = oe_col_loc }
                oe_col_settle_p2 = yes
            }
            remove_variable = oe_col_p2_group
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 71 }
            var:oe_col_req_loc ?= { save_scope_as = oe_col_site }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_site scope:oe_col_site = { oe_col_site_can_open = yes } }
                scope:oe_col_site = {
                    oe_col_post_open = yes
                    owner ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_col_op_post target = c:BYZ } }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            OR = { this = location:kaffa this = location:tana }
                            NOT = { owner ?= { oe_col_genoese = yes } }
                            country_exists = c:GEN
                        }
                        c:GEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_col_op_rival_post target = c:BYZ } }
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = oe_col_voucher var:oe_col_req_paid ?= 0 }
                    remove_variable = oe_col_voucher
                }
                oe_col_post_count = yes
            }
            else = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_req_paid } add_gold = var:oe_col_req_paid } }
            oe_col_req_clear = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 72 }
            var:oe_col_req_loc ?= { save_scope_as = oe_col_site }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_site scope:oe_col_site = { oe_col_site_can_open = yes } }
                save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_col_pay value = oe_col_cost_price }
                scope:oe_col_site = { owner ?= { add_gold = scope:oe_col_pay } }
                scope:oe_col_site = {
                    oe_col_post_open = yes
                    owner ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_col_op_post target = c:BYZ } }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            OR = { this = location:kaffa this = location:tana }
                            NOT = { owner ?= { oe_col_genoese = yes } }
                            country_exists = c:GEN
                        }
                        c:GEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_col_op_rival_post target = c:BYZ } }
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = oe_col_voucher var:oe_col_req_paid ?= 0 }
                    remove_variable = oe_col_voucher
                }
                oe_col_post_count = yes
            }
            else = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_req_paid } add_gold = var:oe_col_req_paid } }
            oe_col_req_clear = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 73 }
            var:oe_col_req_loc ?= { save_scope_as = oe_col_site }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_site scope:oe_col_site = { oe_col_site_can_open = yes } }
                oe_itp_shift = { r = gen n = 1 }
                scope:oe_col_site = {
                    oe_col_post_open = yes
                    owner ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_col_op_post target = c:BYZ } }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            OR = { this = location:kaffa this = location:tana }
                            NOT = { owner ?= { oe_col_genoese = yes } }
                            country_exists = c:GEN
                        }
                        c:GEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_col_op_rival_post target = c:BYZ } }
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = oe_col_voucher var:oe_col_req_paid ?= 0 }
                    remove_variable = oe_col_voucher
                }
                oe_col_post_count = yes
            }
            else = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_req_paid } add_gold = var:oe_col_req_paid } }
            oe_col_req_clear = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 74 }
            add_gold = oe_col_req_refund
            var:oe_col_req_loc ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_cd months = 60 } }
            oe_col_req_clear = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 76 }
            var:oe_col_close_loc ?= {
                if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post }
                    owner ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_col_op_closed target = c:BYZ } }
                    oe_col_post_drop = { why = 0 }
                }
            }
            remove_variable = oe_col_close_loc
            oe_col_post_count = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 77 }
            var:oe_col_thr_at ?= {
                oe_col_post_fortify = yes
                if = {
                    limit = { owner ?= { OR = { oe_col_genoese = yes oe_col_venetian = yes } } }
                    owner ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_col_op_closed target = c:BYZ } }
                }
            }
            oe_col_post_count = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 78 }
            var:oe_col_thr_at ?= {
                owner ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_col_op_guest target = c:BYZ } }
                set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_thr_cd years = 10 }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 79 }
            oe_ecc_pres_add = { amount = 2 }
            var:oe_col_thr_at ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_col_post_thr_cd years = 10 } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 81 }
            var:oe_col_c30_seat ?= {
                add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_col_veterans years = 20 mode = replace }
            }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_seat } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_seat }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_theme } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_theme }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_new } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_new }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_cmp } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_cmp }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 82 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_col_c30_theme ?= { oe_ta_can_change_course = yes oe_ta_course_ok_navy = yes } }
                var:oe_col_c30_theme = {
                    oe_ta_set_course = { course = navy }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_focus_cd years = 5 }
                }
            }
            else = { add_gold = oe_col_m1 set_variable = { name = oe_col_fc_fail value = 6 } }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_seat } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_seat }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_theme } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_theme }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_new } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_new }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_cmp } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_cmp }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_col_job ?= 83 }
            var:oe_col_c30_seat ?= { save_scope_as = oe_col_loc }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_loc }
                oe_col_find_source = yes
                if = {
                    limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_src exists = scope:oe_col_amt }
                    add_migration = {
                        owner = root
                        from = scope:oe_col_src.province_definition
                        to_location = scope:oe_col_loc
                        amount = scope:oe_col_amt
                        months = 24
                        only_from_owned_locations = yes
                        keep_nationality = yes
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_pop_added } }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_pop_added value = 0 }
                    }
                    change_variable = { name = oe_col_pop_added add = { value = scope:oe_col_amt multiply = 24 } }
                    scope:oe_col_loc = {
                        add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_col_homesteads years = 10 mode = replace }
                    }
                    scope:oe_col_loc = {
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_cd years = 20 }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_kind value = 1 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_s1_loc } }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_s1_loc value = scope:oe_col_loc }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_s1_m value = 24 }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_s1_kind value = 1 }
                    }
                    else_if = {
                        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_s2_loc } }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_s2_loc value = scope:oe_col_loc }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_s2_m value = 24 }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_s2_kind value = 1 }
                    }
                }
            }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_seat } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_seat }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_theme } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_theme }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_new } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_new }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_c30_cmp } remove_variable = oe_col_c30_cmp }
        }
        remove_variable = oe_col_job
    }
}
